notes: The published int8 file of litert-community/decider-2b-vision-LiteRT (Hub commit 6c024e94) through the Android library: the hfmodels-android sample app samples/ask on litertlm-android 0.16.1, side-loaded (the SDK imported the pushed file and verified the sha256 of its descriptor, 5fb2e19a..., 3,171,081,088 B). The same artifact measured with the LiteRT-LM CLI is data/device_runs/0.16.0/2026-09-29/decider-2b-vision-int8__galaxy-s26.json; these rows differ in runtime build, harness and prompt, so they sit beside it under a signature that names the harness. The times are walls measured by the app, not the runtime's benchmark figures, and the app states no token counts: ttft_ms and the throughput fields stay null and the walls are in metrics. The shape matters: the app keeps ONE conversation per model load (the picture and the first question in turn 1, the other four questions as text-only turns). A new conversation per request on one loaded model gives answers that differ from a fresh-state run on this model (google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM#3165; hfmodels-android samples/pong on the same phone and day: 33/60, 32/60 and 34/60 letters equal to the fresh-state reference with pixel-identical inputs), so that shape has no row here.
quantization: dynamic int8 fully connected weights, int8 token embedding (channelwise); vision encoder and adapter fp16; fp32 activation preference declared on the decoder section
